# robinhood-chain-x402

> x402 payment rail for USDG on Robinhood Chain: spec-conformant exact/EIP-3009 middleware, client fetch wrapper, self-hostable facilitator.

robinhood-chain-x402 is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
